scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
You are now a member of our select brethren. I can still remember when I first met you.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
你已成为我们精英兄弟会的一员。我依然记得初次与你相遇的情景。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
There are many paths one can take in the world. Most people can see their path but don't really follow it...
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
世间有许多道路。大多数人能看见自己的路，却未必真正去追随它...

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
The Rune Knight is waiting for you at Glast Heim. He will guide you to the entrance of Glast Heim Tower.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
卢恩骑士正在格拉斯特海姆等你。他会指引你前往中央塔的入口。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
Don't you have things to do right now?
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
你现在不是还有事要忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
Strive to live the way of the sword with honor...
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
以荣誉践行剑之道...

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
Cheers to our new future...
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
为我们崭新的未来干杯...

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
Anyway the drinks here are really good. Would you like to have one?
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
这里的酒真的很不错。你想来一杯吗？

scripts.text: Sure, let's have a drink.
scripts.translation: 好啊，喝一杯吧

scripts.text: I refuse.
scripts.translation: 我拒绝

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
Are you sure? You don't know the true elegance of these drinks...
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
你确定吗？你并不了解这些酒真正的优雅之处...

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
You walk the way of sword too don't you? Then we can understand each other. Drinks taste better when it's with a fellow Swordman.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
你也行走在剑之道上，对吧？那我们便能互相理解。与同为剑士的人一起喝酒，味道会更好。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
I believe that the wind of change is not always a good one.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
我相信，变革之风并不总是美好的。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
I'll buy this round.
A toast to friendship~
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
这一轮我请客。
为友谊干杯~

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
In my opinion you seem to be ready to start a new way...
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
在我看来，你似乎已经准备好开启新的道路了...

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
If you continually walk the way of the sword, you will eventually feel the limits of your powers. Like myself before...
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
如果你持续行走在剑之道上，终将感受到自身力量的极限。就像曾经的我自己...

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
Walking the way of the sword is a perpetual battle. From now on you may have a rough journey ahead of you...
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
行走在剑之道上是一场永恒的战役。从今往后，你的旅途或许会充满艰辛...

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
If you want to walk on your new way and surpass your current limits, I'm willing to help you.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
如果你想踏上新的道路并突破目前的极限，我愿意帮助你。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
The true way of a Swordman who learned harmony to break the limit of a sword is a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
真正领悟了和谐以突破剑之极限的剑士之道，便是卢恩骑士。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
Won't you join our brethren? You look like you're fully qualified to become one of us.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
你愿意加入我们的兄弟会吗？你看起来完全有资格成为我们的一员。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
If you are interested, I'll introduce you to the masters who will guide you to the way of the Rune Knight with my recommendation.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
如果你感兴趣，我会引荐给你那些能指引你走上卢恩骑士之道的师父，并附上我的推荐。

scripts.text: I am not ready yet.
scripts.translation: 我还没准备好。

scripts.text: I'm ready to be a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation: 我准备好成为卢恩骑士了。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
Right. Every challenge always needs preparation. Okay, I'll wait for you.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
没错。每一次挑战都需要充分的准备。好吧，我会等你。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
Of course, I would only accept you if you are one hundred percent sure of your conviction to become a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
当然，只有当你百分之百确信自己立志成为卢恩骑士时，我才会接纳你。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
You're sure now?
Let me send a dispatch to my comrades that you are willing to join our ranks.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
你现在确定了吗？
让我向我的同志们发个信，告诉他们你愿意加入我们。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
You know the place called Glast Heim? There's a Rune Knight waiting for you there, he will guide you to the entrance of Glast Heim Tower.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
你知道格拉斯特海姆这个地方吗？那里有一位卢恩骑士在等你，他会指引你前往中央塔的入口。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
My name is Manuel. I am called the Rune Knight of Brilliance. When you tell him that you are a Rune Knight candidate with my recommendation, he will handle the rest.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
我叫曼努埃尔，被称为光辉的卢恩骑士。当你告诉他你是带着我推荐的卢恩骑士候选人时，剩下的事就交给他了。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
I will wait for the day that you become our comrade as a true Rune Knight.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
我会等待你成为真正的卢恩骑士，成为我们同志的那一天。

scripts.text: If you continually walk the way of the sword, you will eventually feel the limits of your powers. Like myself before...
scripts.translation: 如果你一直行走在剑之道上，终有一天你会感到力量的极限。就像以前的我一样...

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
When the time comes there will be a way to help you surpass that limit. Until the day that your strength has grown comes, we can at least still have a drink together.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
到时候，会有办法帮助你突破那个极限。在力量增长的那一天到来之前，我们至少还可以一起喝一杯。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
A toast to the day that your strength can withstand the powers of a Rune Knight!
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
为了你那足以承受卢恩骑士之力的强大力量，干杯！

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
Just like the taste of this drink. I wish the taste of this drink is kept here forever.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
就像这酒的味道一样。我希望这酒的味道能永远留在这里。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
Tell him that you are a candidate to be a Rune Knight and he will handle the rest.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
告诉他你是卢恩骑士的候选人，剩下的事就交给他了。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
I will wait for the day you become our comrade as a true Rune Knight.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
我会等待你成为真正的卢恩骑士，成为我们同志的那一天。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Manuel]
No? Well then never mind.
Don't you love the smell of alcohol?
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 曼努埃尔]
不吗？那就算了。
你不喜欢酒的味道吗？

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
Oh, you must be {0}.
Welcome.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
哦，你就是{0}吧。
欢迎。

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
I am the only knight who's keeping the way of the Swordsman in this cursed place Glast Heim.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
我是这个被诅咒的地方——格拉斯特海姆中，唯一坚守剑士之道的骑士。

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
Are you a cursed ghost of this place? Or are you an ignorant adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
你是这个地方的诅咒幽灵？还是一个无知的冒险者？

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
The 1st assignment is to find out our Rune Knight gathering place hidden inside of Glast Heim.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
第一个任务是找出隐藏在格拉斯特海姆内部的卢恩骑士集会地点。

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
It seems that you are still taking the test. Do your best and pass all the tests.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
看来你还在接受测试。加油，通过所有的测试。

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
We are looking forward to you helping the Rune Knights spread honor throughout the world.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
我们期待你能协助卢恩骑士，将荣耀传遍整个世界。

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
So, What can I help you with?
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
那么，有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: I want to go to the gathering place.
scripts.translation: 我想去集会地点。

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
Right. I'll send you right now. I'll see you soon.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
好的。我现在就送你过去。回头见。

scripts.text: I am the only knight who's keeping the way of the Swordsman in this cursed place Glast Heim.
scripts.translation: 我是这个被诅咒的地方——格拉斯特海姆中，唯一坚守剑士之道的骑士。

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
Since you don't walk the way of the Sword, you wouldn't understand our spirit. I can manage by myself. Follow your own path.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
既然你不走剑之道，就无法理解我们的精神。我自己能应付。请走你自己的路。

scripts.text: Are you a cursed ghost of this place? Or are you an ignorant adventurer?
scripts.translation: 你是这个地方的诅咒幽灵？还是一个无知的冒险者？

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
If you are a breathing human, then listen to me carefully. I wouldn't risk my life here by hesitating to talk to just anyone.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
如果你是一个有呼吸的人类，那就仔细听我说。我不会因为犹豫是否要和陌生人交谈而在这里冒生命危险。

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你来这里做什么？

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
I am the only knight who's keeping the way of the Swordsman in this cursed place Glast Heim.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
我是这个被诅咒的地方——格拉斯特海姆中，唯一坚守剑士之道的骑士。

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
If you also follow the way of the Swordsman our paths will most certainly cross again when you have reached your full potential.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
如果你也遵循剑士之道，当你发挥全部潜力时，我们的道路一定会再次交汇。

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
I am a man walking the way of the Sword. But I'm not exactly the same as the likes of you, Rune-Midgarts knight.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
我是一个行走于剑之道的男子。但我并不像你们卢恩·米德加兹的骑士那样。

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
We are not like the other Knights who are absorbed with pomp and circumstance so you may not know of us yet.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
我们不同于那些沉迷于排场和仪式的其他骑士，所以你可能还不太了解我们。

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
We are the Rune Knights. A group that leads the true power as well as the physical strength to the righteous way of the Sword.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
我们是卢恩骑士。一个引领真正力量与肉体力量走向剑之正道的团体。

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
We have been living in secret here in the deep of Glast Heim for a half century but it's time to let the world know our purpose.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
我们在格拉斯特海姆深处秘密生活了半个世纪，但现在是让世界知道我们目的的时候了。

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
Now there are many instructors who are looking for talented Sword wielders in various places of Rune-Midgarts. They are looking for a people who will join the true way of the Sword.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
现在，卢恩·米德加兹各地有许多导师正在寻找有天赋的剑士。他们在寻找愿意加入剑之正道的人。

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
If you wish to join the Rune Knights. Please get a recommendation from one of the guides and come to me again.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
如果你想加入卢恩骑士，请从其中一位向导那里获得推荐，然后再来找我。

scripts.text: I came to be a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation: 我来成为卢恩骑士。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
Um... Are you the Rune Knight candidate that Manuel talked about?
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
嗯...你是曼努埃尔提到的那位卢恩骑士候选人吗？

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
Your name is {0}, right? I can see clearly that you are qualified to become our comrade.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
你的名字是{0}，对吧？我清楚地看到你有资格成为我们的同志。

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
Good. I don't have to ask any more about your qualification to join our brethren....1.S... Now I'll give you your first assignment.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
很好。我不必再询问你加入我们兄弟会的资格了...现在，我将给你第一个任务。

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
Find our Rune Knight gathering place hidden inside of Glast Heim.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
找出隐藏在格拉斯特海姆内部的卢恩骑士集会地点。

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
There's a place that leads to the Rune Knight's secret gathering room inside the Glast Heim Chivalry. Find that place by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
在格拉斯特海姆骑士团内部，有一个通往卢恩骑士秘密集会室的地方。请你自己找到那里。

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
If you can find it, there'll be a person waiting to greet you, so let's start.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
如果你能找到那里，会有人等着迎接你。那么，开始吧。

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
Of course your life might be at risk by the ghosts of Glast Heim... but overcoming the risk shouldn't be hard for a Rune Knight candidate.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
当然，格拉斯特海姆的幽灵可能会威胁到你的生命...但对于一名卢恩骑士候选人来说，克服这种风险应该不难。

scripts.text: The 1st assignment is to find out our Rune Knight gathering place hidden inside of Glast Heim.
scripts.translation: 第一个任务是找出隐藏在格拉斯特海姆内部的卢恩骑士集会地点。

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
There's a place that leads to the Rune Knights' secret gathering place inside Glast Heim Chivalry. Find that place by yourself.
scripts.translation:

在格拉斯特海姆骑士团内部，有一个通往卢恩骑士秘密集会室的地方。请你自己找到那里。

scripts.translation:

scripts.text: It seems that you are still taking the test. Do your best and pass all the tests.
scripts.translation: 看来你还在接受测试。加油，通过所有的测试。

scripts.text: I want to go to the gathering place.
scripts.translation: 我想去集会地点。

scripts.text: Quit the conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Rune Leader Jungberg]
All right. I'll send you right away. I'll check you later.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩首领 荣格伯格]
好的。我马上送你过去。之后我会再检查你的情况。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Staff]
Welcome, {0}. Are you going to the gathering place?
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士团职员]
欢迎，{0}。你是要去集会地点吗？

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Staff]
Ah... this area is off limits, you are prohibited to be here. Please do not do anything to hinder our efforts.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士团职员]
啊...这个区域是禁区，禁止你在此逗留。请不要做任何阻碍我们行动的事情。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Staff]
You found this place correctly. Jungberg sent me to send you to the gathering place.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士团职员]
你正确地找到了这个地方。荣格伯格派我送你前往集会地点。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Staff]
Wait! This place is prohibited. I don't mind you wandering about but, don't ever disturb me again.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士团职员]
等等！这里是禁区。我不介意你四处游荡，但别再打扰我了。

scripts.text: Yes, take me there.
scripts.translation: 是的，带我去吧

scripts.text: I'm on other business.
scripts.translation: 我有其他事要办

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Staff]
Okay, come in. I'll guide you.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士团职员]
好的，请进。我会指引你。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Staff]
Oh, really? Then, keep on your work. I'll continue with my mission.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士团职员]
哦，是吗？那你继续你的工作吧。我也要继续执行我的任务了。

scripts.text: Ah... this area is off limits, you are prohibited to be here. Please do not do anything to hinder our efforts.
scripts.translation: 啊...这个区域是禁区，禁止你在此逗留。请不要做任何阻碍我们行动的事情。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Staff]
Although... you seem to have the potential to become a companion to those who follow the path of the sword.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士团职员]
不过...你似乎有潜力成为那些追随剑道之人的同伴。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Staff]
I'm sure we'll be crossing paths before long. I believe we will meet again.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士团职员]
我相信我们很快就会再次相遇。我相信我们会再见的。

scripts.text: You found this place correctly. Jungberg sent me to send you to the gathering place.
scripts.translation: 你正确地找到了这个地方。荣格伯格派我送你前往集会地点。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Staff]
When you get into the gathering place, talk to Captain Tigris. He's always waiting for new members to show up.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士团职员]
到达集会地点后，请去找船长提格里斯。他总是在那里等待新成员的到来。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Staff]
Well, please follow me.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士团职员]
那么，请跟我来。

scripts.text: Wait! This place is prohibited. I don't mind you wandering about but, don't ever disturb me again.
scripts.translation: 站住！这里是禁区。我不介意你四处游荡，但请不要再打扰我了。

scripts.text: You've got too many things. You cannot proceed anymore. Please try again after losing some weight.
scripts.translation: 你携带的物品太多了，无法继续前进。请减轻负重后再试。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Oh, I see... Please wait a moment.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
哦，我明白了...请稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Hey, long time no see, {0}. I don't think you've got any important matters to discuss but make yourself comfortable.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
嘿，好久不见，{0}。我想你应该没有什么重要的事情要谈吧，那就请自便吧。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
I forgot to check if you are qualified to get the celebration gift for changing your job...
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
我忘了确认你是否符合领取转职庆典礼物的资格...

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Let me check the report from the instructors who took care of your tests.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
让我查看一下负责你测试的教官提交的报告。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Hm... This is perfect. You've come here with very rare good records.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
嗯...这很完美。你带着非常罕见的优秀记录来到这里。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Hmm... This is great. You've come here with decent records.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
嗯...这很不错。你带着不错的记录来到这里。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Hmm, not bad. It's not a great record but you tried your best.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
嗯，还不错。虽然不是特别优秀的记录，但你已经尽力了。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Here, take this. It's a gift that I like to give to the younger generation like yourself.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
拿着，这是给你的。这是我喜欢送给像你这样的年轻一代的礼物。

scripts.text: A man wearing glorious armor and passion in his eyes is standing in front of me.
scripts.translation: 一位身穿辉煌铠甲、眼中充满热情的男子正站在我面前。

scripts.text: He stares at me with an absent look and after a while he begins to talk.
scripts.translation: 他目光空洞地看着我，过了一会儿，他开始说话了。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Hey, are you the Rune Knight candidate that Manuel recommended? I am Captain Tigris from the Rune Knights, and your name is?
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
嘿，你是马努埃尔推荐的那位卢恩骑士候选人吗？我是卢恩骑士团的船长提格里斯，请问你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Oh, I've heard it before but I've forgotten it. Right, were you {0}? I truly welcome you from the heart for coming here.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
哦，我好像听过这个名字，但忘了。对了，你是{0}吧？我发自内心地欢迎你来到这里。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Let's see. How many candidates have come to this room? Hey, Lunarea, which candidate is this one here?
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
让我看看。有多少候选人来到这个房间了？嘿，露娜蕾雅，这位是哪位候选人？

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Lunarea]
... 172nd.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 露娜蕾雅]
...第172位。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
She says so my friend. Actually I don't want to see the next one. So please do well.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
她说你是第172位，我的朋友。其实我不想再看到下一位了。所以请好好表现。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Let me see... Manual and Jungberg must have finished the basic verification, then let's start the test right away.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
让我看看...马努埃尔和荣格伯格应该已经完成了基本验证，那么让我们立刻开始测试吧。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Lunarea, proceed with the first test.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
露娜蕾雅，开始第一项测试。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Lunarea]
...
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 露娜蕾雅]
...

scripts.text: This pale-skinned female Rune Knight called Lunarea is nodding her head quietly and watching me.
scripts.translation: 这位皮肤白皙的卢恩骑士露娜蕾雅静静地点了点头，注视着我。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
The test begins now. First, you'll get the 1st test from that beautiful icy lady, so please try your best.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
测试现在开始。首先，你要接受那位美丽而冷峻的女士的第一项测试，请全力以赴。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
When the test is done, talk to me. Anyway you'll need to care about the tests progressing with other people.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
测试结束后，来找我。总之，你需要留意其他候选人的测试进度。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Well then, I'll be waiting here so take the test.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
那么，我就在这里等着，去接受测试吧。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Now the test begins. First, you'll get the 1st test from that beautiful icy lady, so please try your best.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
测试现在开始。首先，你要接受那位美丽而冷峻的女士的第一项测试，请全力以赴。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
When the test is done, talk to me... anyway you'll need to care about the tests progressing with other people.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
测试结束后，来找我...总之，你需要留意其他候选人的测试进度。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Well then, I'll be waiting here so take the test.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
那么，我就在这里等着，去接受测试吧。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Hey you, weren't you testing? Lunarea, what happened? Is the test all done?
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
喂，你不是在测试吗？露娜蕾雅，发生什么事了？测试都结束了吗？

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Lunarea]
......
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 露娜蕾雅]
......

scripts.text: She just shakes her head without saying any word, and stares at me. She has piercing eyes.
scripts.translation: 她一言不发地摇了摇头，盯着我看。她的眼神锐利。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Okay Lunarea. Hey, listen to me carefully. Lunarea is a poor talker and quiet but you shouldn't ignore her.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
好了，露娜蕾雅。喂，仔细听我说。露娜蕾雅不擅长说话，性格安静，但你不能忽视她。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Even for me... no, any one of us who upsets her wouldn't be able to deal with that.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
即使是像我...不，我们任何人惹怒了她，都应付不了后果。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Lunarea]
......
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 露娜蕾雅]
......

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Whoa don't look at me like that. Okay, you see that? Aspiring Rune Knight. Go back to Lunarea and take the test as she says. That'll be good for you.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
哇，别那样看着我。好吧，你看到了吗？这位渴望成为卢恩骑士的人。回到露娜蕾雅那里，按照她的指示接受测试。这对你是有好处的。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Umm, it seems that you've passed Lunarea's test? I guess I won't have to test more for the basics.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
嗯，看来你已经通过了露娜蕾雅的测试？我想我不必再进行基础测试了。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Undeniably our Rune Knights have some differences but we should not forget our Swordsman roots.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
不可否认，我们的卢恩骑士各有不同，但我们不应忘记自己的剑士根源。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
From now on, this will be the real test as a Rune Knight that you want to be. You'll need to prepare to take next test.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
从现在开始，这才是你作为卢恩骑士的真正考验。你需要为下一项测试做好准备。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Renoa, I know that you've been waiting for a long time but it's your turn.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
雷诺阿，我知道你已经等了很久，但轮到你了。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
It really has been such a long time but Lunarea's test and mine differ like the sky to the earth. I hope you won't be just a muscle-headed fool.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
确实等了很久，但露娜蕾雅的测试和我的测试天差地别。希望你不要只是个四肢发达的傻瓜。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Hahaha. you heard that? It won't be easy this time. I hope you get through it my friend.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
哈哈，你听到了吗？这次可不容易。我希望你能顺利通过，我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Go to that fiery lady in the library room to get the next test done and come back.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
去图书馆房间找那位火爆的女士完成下一项测试，然后回来。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Now, this will be the real test as a Rune Knight. You've got to prepare to take the next test.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
现在，这才是作为卢恩骑士的真正考验。你需要为下一项测试做好准备。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Renoa, I know that you've been waiting for a long time but it's your turn.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
雷诺阿，我知道你已经等了很久，但轮到你了。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
It really has been such a long time but Lunarea's test and mine differ like the sky to the earth. I hope you won't be just a muscle-headed fool.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
确实等了很久，但露娜蕾雅的测试和我的测试天差地别。希望你不要只是个四肢发达的傻瓜。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Hahaha. you heard that? It won't be easy this time. I hope you get through it my friend.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
哈哈，你听到了吗？这次可不容易。我希望你能顺利通过，我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Go to that fiery lady in the library room to get the next test done and come back.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
去图书馆房间找那位火爆的女士完成下一项测试，然后回来。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Oh, I heard that you've passed Renoa's test which only few people could pass.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
哦，我听说你通过了雷诺阿的测试，那可是只有少数人能通过的。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
I heard that the number of candidates who've given up while taking Renoa's test has been high.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
我听说在参加雷诺阿测试的候选人中，放弃的人数相当多。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
You have to understand. I think it was the test that shows exactly the test instructor's personality. Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
你要明白。我觉得那项测试完全体现了考试指导员的个性。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Now, there's only the last test left. When you pass this, you will be on your way to officially becoming a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
现在只剩下最后一项测试了。通过这项测试，你就正式踏上成为卢恩骑士的道路了。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Take the final test from the Rune Knight Velpino who is at the arsenal's right side.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
去军械库右侧找卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺接受最终测试。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
I'm not kidding, I am really looking forward to your new start as a Rune Knight.
So please do your best.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
我没开玩笑，我真的非常期待你作为卢恩骑士的新起点。
所以请全力以赴。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Take the final test from the Rune Knight Velpino who is at the arsenal's right side.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
去军械库右侧找卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺接受最终测试。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
I'm not kidding, I am really looking forward to your new start as a Rune Knight. So please do your best.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
我没开玩笑，我真的非常期待你作为卢恩骑士的新起点。所以请全力以赴。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Congratulations. Now you've passed all the tests and can walk the way of a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
恭喜。现在你已经通过了所有测试，可以踏上卢恩骑士的道路了。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
I'm happy from the bottom of my heart. I'm very proud of you.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
我从心底感到高兴。我为你感到骄傲。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Now you can be yourself around us and stand proud as one of us.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
现在你可以做你自己，并作为我们的一员自豪地站立。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
There's the evaluations from Lunarea, Renoa and Velpino who took care of your tests.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
这里有露娜蕾雅、雷诺阿和维尔皮诺对你测试的评价。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
It's not much but there are some gifts for new Rune Knights who got good scores on the tests.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
虽然不多，但这是给在测试中取得好成绩的新卢恩骑士的礼物。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
There will be a difference depending on the scores, but they are all helpful for anyone who is a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
根据分数不同会有所区别，但它们对任何卢恩骑士都有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Lastly, there are several things to be aware of as a Knight who's experienced a job change to a Lord Knight in Valhalla.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
最后，作为在瓦尔哈拉经历职业变更为骑士领主的骑士，有几件事需要注意。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Well, my job is done now. Would you like to start your new life as a Rune Knight?
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
好了，我的任务完成了。你想开始你作为卢恩骑士的新生活吗？

scripts.text: Every preparation is done.
scripts.translation: 一切准备就绪。

scripts.text: I need more time to think.
scripts.translation: 我需要更多时间考虑。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Weren't you listening?
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
你刚才没在听吗？

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
If you understood, then make your preparations and come back.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
如果你明白了，那就做好准备后再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
It seems not enough?
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
看来还不够呢？

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Please unequip your mount and come back again.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
请卸下坐骑，然后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Our Master, Beljeve... and the Great Sage, Serpeone...
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
我们的师父贝尔杰夫...以及大贤者瑟佩奥恩...

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
This Knight is going to walk the way of the Rune Knights with us, so please give your blessing.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
这位骑士将与我们一同踏上卢恩骑士的道路，请赐予祝福。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Congratulations.
You are now an honorable Rune Knight.
Remember this day from this day forth!
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
恭喜。
你现在是一位光荣的卢恩骑士了。
请铭记这一天！

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
There's a royal gift from the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom for all new Rune Knights.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
卢恩·米德加兹王国为所有新晋卢恩骑士准备了王室礼物。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Give me a second to get the royal gift and talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
请稍等，我去取王室礼物，然后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
I don't know how you were able to get here. But it looks like you've come to a place where you shouldn't be.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
我不知道你是怎么来到这里的。但看起来你来到了不该来的地方。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Go back to where you belong.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
回到你该去的地方吧。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
If there's any equipment that you are wearing now, or anything you're holding. Please empty it for your job change moment.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
如果你身上还穿着装备，或者手里拿着东西，请在转职前全部清空。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Talk to the Kafra Employee to use the storage.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
去找卡普拉 职员使用仓库。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
You might know already, if you are riding a Peco Peco, you should have left it behind. If you brought it, leave it and come again.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
你可能已经知道了，如果你骑着大嘴鸟，应该把它留在外面。如果你带它来了，请把它留下再回来。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
One more thing. If you have any remaining skill-points, use it all and learn the skills. You won't be able to change jobs if you have any more skill points.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
还有一件事。如果你还有剩余的技能点，请全部用完并学习技能。如果还有剩余技能点，将无法转职。

scripts.text: She holds up her chin quietly, nods lightly and notices me.
scripts.translation: 她静静地抬起下巴，轻轻点了点头，注意到了我。

scripts.text: Then after a moment she puts her face down and seems absorbed with other thoughts.
scripts.translation: 过了一会儿，她低下头，似乎陷入了沉思。

scripts.text: She finally opens her mouth and begins to talk.
scripts.translation: 她终于开口说话了。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Lunarea]
5 minutes... When you endure and get rid of all, you succeed.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 露娜蕾雅]
5分钟...当你忍耐并消除一切，你就成功了。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Lunarea]
In this test, Captain Tigris, Renoa, Velpino and I will visit together.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 露娜蕾雅]
在这次考验中，船长 提格里斯、雷诺瓦、韦尔皮诺和我将一同前往。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Lunarea]
If you want to, you can ask help from one of us. But don't think that we will always help.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 露娜蕾雅]
如果你愿意，可以向我们其中一人求助。但不要以为我们会一直帮助你。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Lunarea]
Since it's a test, getting help from us is completely your choice. It doesn't matter if you take the test with our help or all by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 露娜蕾雅]
既然是考验，是否接受我们的帮助完全由你决定。无论是有我们的协助还是独自完成，都没有关系。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Lunarea]
When you are ready to go to the test field talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 露娜蕾雅]
当你准备好前往考验场地时，请与我对话。

scripts.text: Move to the test field now.
scripts.translation: 现在前往考验场地

scripts.text: Give me time to get ready.
scripts.translation: 给我一点准备时间

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Lunarea]
Did you fail? But, there's no limitation to the number of times you can try.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 露娜蕾雅]
你失败了吗？不过，尝试的次数是没有限制的。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Lunarea]
If you want to take the test again. I can send you to the test field.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 露娜蕾雅]
如果你想再次接受考验，我可以将你传送到考验场地。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Lunarea]
5 minutes... When you endure and get rid of all, you succeed.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 露娜蕾雅]
5分钟...当你忍耐并消除一切，你就成功了。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Lunarea]
If you are ready to move to the test field talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 露娜蕾雅]
当你准备好前往考验场地时，请与我对话。

scripts.text: Move to the test field now.
scripts.translation: 现在前往考验场地

scripts.text: Please give me time to prepare.
scripts.translation: 请给我一点准备时间

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Lunarea]
Once someone enters into the test field you cannot enter directly. The test is taken one by one.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 露娜蕾雅]
一旦有人进入考验场地，其他人就不能直接进入。考验必须逐一进行。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Lunarea]
When it's your turn to enter you will be sent there directly.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 露娜蕾雅]
轮到你的时候，你会被直接传送过去。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Lunarea]
Was your test successful?
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 露娜蕾雅]
你的考验成功了吗？

scripts.text: She shows a small smile which is barely visible and looks at me.
scripts.translation: 她露出一丝几乎看不见的微笑，看着我。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Lunarea]
This portion of the test is over. Go talk to Captain Tigris.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 露娜蕾雅]
这一部分的考验结束了。去和船长 提格里斯谈谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Lunarea]
This portion of the test is over. Go talk to Captain Tigris.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 露娜蕾雅]
这一部分的考验结束了。去和船长 提格里斯谈谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Lunarea]
There are other tests you need to complete. I hope you do a good job.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 露娜蕾雅]
还有其他考验需要你完成。希望你能表现良好。

scripts.text: This pale-skinned absent-looking female Rune Knight doesn't seem to care. Of course she doesn't seem interested with my existence
scripts.translation: 这位肤色苍白、神情恍惚的女性卢恩骑士似乎毫不在意。当然，她看起来对我的存在毫无兴趣。

scripts.text: She nods her head and reaches out her hand lightly. Then she draws her sword and makes a signal.
scripts.translation: 她点了点头，轻轻伸出手。随后她拔出剑，做了一个手势。

scripts.text: But her expression suddenly changed a bit as she looked at to speak.
scripts.translation: 但当她看向我要说话时，她的表情突然微微变化。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Lunarea]
Now... the testing room is currently occupied...
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 露娜蕾雅]
现在...考验室正被占用...

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Lunarea]
You'll have to wait... it is regulation that the test must take place one by one.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 露娜蕾雅]
你得等等...规定考验必须逐一进行。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Lunarea]
Just wait 5 minutes and it should be your turn.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 露娜蕾雅]
只需等待5分钟，应该就轮到你了。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Congratulations for becoming one of us. Junior Rune Knight, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
恭喜你成为我们的一员。
见习卢恩骑士，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Are you the one who wants to be a Rune Knight? There have been so many today.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
你是想成为卢恩骑士的人吗？今天来的人可真多啊。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Finally! Is it my turn? I'm so happy.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
终于！轮到我了？我好开心。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Well first, I'll give you an assignment. Let's start by studying. Go to the library and study these books.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
首先，我会给你布置一个任务。让我们从学习开始吧。去图书馆研读这些书。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Have you read all the books from the library? It won't be easy to read but if you are determined to be a Rune Knight, you have to have this kind of basic knowledge.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
你把图书馆的书都读完了吗？虽然读起来不容易，但如果你决心成为卢恩骑士，就必须具备这些基础知识。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
If you are ready I'll open the way to the sage, Serpeone who's in the Midgard post at Ash-Vacuum. Are you prepared?
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
如果你准备好了，我会为你打开通往米德加尔特阿什真空站贤者瑟佩奥恩的道路。你准备好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Umm, you're back? How's it like in the Ash-Vacuum?
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
嗯，你回来了？阿什真空站那边怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
In this test you will be making a rune stone yourself which is going to be used for your last test.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
在这次考验中，你需要亲手制作一块符文石，它将用于你的最终考验。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Become a proud Rune Knight.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
成为一名自豪的卢恩骑士吧。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
How... how did you get in here?! Captain, we have a spy!
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
你...你是怎么进来的？！船长，我们有间谍！

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Soon you'll see the way we need to go clearly.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
很快，你就会看清我们需要走的路了。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Until then, I'll be here to discover more candidates just like you.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
在那之前，我会留在这里发掘更多像你一样的候选人。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
It's too bad that there haven't been many candidates that have made it to my part of the test yet so I'm just taking a bit of a rest.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
很遗憾，能走到我这一关的候选人并不多，所以我正稍微休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
If you are taking the Rune Knight test I hope that you try your best. This won't be as easy to pass as Lunarea's test ok?
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
如果你正在参加卢恩骑士的考验，我希望你能全力以赴。这可比露娜蕾雅的考验难多了，明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
There have been so many candidates failing Lunarea's test that I've given up counting.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
在露娜蕾雅的考验中失败的人太多了，我连数都懒得数了。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
I am Renoa. I am in charge of the teaching and testing of runes and magic for Rune Knight candidates.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
我是雷诺阿。我负责卢恩骑士候选人的符文与魔法教学及考核。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Thank you for all of your trouble taking the test so far. Okay, anyway.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
感谢你一路坚持参加考验。好了，言归正传。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Well first, I'll give you an assignment. Let's start by studying. Go to the library and study these books.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
首先，我会给你布置一个任务。让我们从学习开始吧。去图书馆研读这些书。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Umm, ^0000FFRunes and Rune Knights^000000, ^0000FFThe Principles of Runes^000000, ^0000FFThe Making and use of Runes^000000. Start with these 3...
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
嗯，^0000FF符文与卢恩骑士^000000、^0000FF符文原理^000000、^0000FF符文的制作与使用^000000。先从这三本开始...

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Read the book thoroughly and come back. If you are the type of person who doesn't like reading and studying then it won't be easy for you to live as a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
仔细阅读书籍，然后回来。如果你是不喜欢阅读和学习的人，那么作为卢恩骑士的生活对你来说将不会轻松。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Don't worry, you won't be required to have the same knowledge as the magicians of Geffen or Juno. But you can't be an idiot either.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
别担心，我不要求你拥有吉芬或朱诺魔法师那样的知识。但你也绝不能是个傻瓜。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Umm, ^0000FFRunes and Rune Knights^000000, ^0000FFThe Principles of Runes^000000, ^0000FFThe Making and use of Runes^000000. Start with these 3...
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
嗯，^0000FF符文与卢恩骑士^000000、^0000FF符文原理^000000、^0000FF符文的制作与使用^000000。先从这三本开始...

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Read the book thoroughly and come back. If you are the type of person who doesn't like reading and studying then it won't be easy for you to live as a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
仔细阅读书籍，然后回来。如果你是不喜欢阅读和学习的人，那么作为卢恩骑士的生活对你来说将不会轻松。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Don't worry, you won't be required to have the same knowledge as the magicians of Geffen or Juno. But you can't be an idiot either.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
别担心，我不要求你拥有吉芬或朱诺魔法师那样的知识。但你也绝不能是个傻瓜。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Basically, the power of magic cannot be used without training to draw out the power of nature and the elements.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
基本上，如果不经过训练来引导自然和元素的力量，就无法使用魔法的力量。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Therefore, jobs such as Wizard and Sage have come out and the magic became their own sacred field.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
因此，巫师和贤者这样的职业应运而生，魔法成为了他们神圣的领域。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
The leader of the Rune Knights, Beljeve, is known to have been in touch with the fairies even before the dimensional door of the Ash-Vacuum was made when Satan Morocc resurrected.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
卢恩骑士的首领贝尔杰夫，据称在魔王梦罗克复活、阿什-真空的异次元之门建立之前，就已经与精灵们有过接触。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
I heard a story from the magical scholars about the technology that can substantialize the essence of magic. I began a study to substantialize it to a rune by getting their help.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
我从魔法学者那里听到了关于将魔法本质实体化的技术的故事。在他们的帮助下，我开始研究如何将其转化为符文。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Our Rune Knight's were born from the result of that study, which enables practicing both the power of the sword and magic by using runes.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
我们的卢恩骑士正是这项研究的结果，通过符文，我们得以同时施展剑术和魔法的力量。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
You look like you don't understand why I'm repeating the teaching of the story already written in the book.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
看你的样子，似乎不明白我为什么要重复书中已经写好的故事。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
So for the second test, you need to visit the Laphine magical scholars who had given the direct help to the birth of Rune Knights at Ash-Vacuum.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
所以，作为第二个测试，你需要去拜访那些在阿什-真空直接帮助卢恩骑士诞生的拉芬魔法学者。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Find the sage, Serpeone who's been studying and helping the Rune Knights who are out in the Midgard's camp at Ash-Vacuum.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
找到那位一直在研究并帮助身处阿什-真空米德加尔特营地中的卢恩骑士的贤者瑟佩奥恩。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
The sage has already been in touch with us for a long time so you don't need to worry about understanding Serpeone's language.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
这位贤者已经与我们长期保持联系，所以你不用担心听不懂瑟佩奥恩的语言。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
If you are ready I'll guide you to the warp that moves you directly to Serpeone. Meet her and get instructions from her.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
如果你准备好了，我会指引你前往能直接传送到瑟佩奥恩那里的传送点。去见她，并听从她的指示。

scripts.text: Yes, I am prepared.
scripts.translation: 是的，我准备好了。

scripts.text: Not yet.
scripts.translation: 还没有准备好。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Good. Then I'll send you there now. But, there's one thing I need to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
很好。那么我现在就送你过去。不过，有一件事我需要告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
You will be sent to the Ash-Vacuum. The people dispatched to the Midgard post are certified adventurers and officials.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
你将被传送到阿什-真空。被派遣到米德加尔特据点的人都是经过认证的冒险者和官员。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Beljeve has an agreement with the other alliance countries that the free behavior of our Rune Knights is guaranteed but...
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
贝尔杰夫与其他盟国达成协议，保证我们卢恩骑士的自由行动，但是...

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
If you want to move freely through all of Ash-Vacuum, you'll have to go through the normal route which is acquiring qualification with the Midgard alliance. It has nothing to do with us.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
如果你想自由地在整个阿什-真空行动，就必须通过正常途径获得米德加尔特同盟的资格。这与我们无关。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
The agreement only allows us to send candidates to the Midgard camp and nowhere else.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
该协议只允许我们将候选人送往米德加尔特营地，而不能去其他地方。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
If you are ready talk to me again. I'm free anytime.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
如果你准备好了，再跟我说话。我随时都有空。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Well, a person of your strength must have been there already no?
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
嗯，像你这样实力的人，肯定已经去过那里了吧？

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Now it's time to take the test concerning runes. I know that you have been through quite a complicated process.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
现在该进行关于符文的测试了。我知道你经历了一个相当复杂的过程。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
I am going to give you a test that allows you to deal with runes directly.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
我将给你一项测试，让你直接处理符文。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
In this test you will be making a rune stone yourself which will also be used for your last test.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
在这项测试中，你将亲手制作符文石，它也将用于你最后的测试。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
If you remember what you read in the library just before, you'll be able to produce a rune stone here without my explanation.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
如果你还记得刚才在图书馆读到的内容，你就不需要我的解释，也能在这里制作符文石。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
If you succeed in making the rune stone it will automatically become the rune stone you'll use for yourself when you become a Rune Knight, so try your best.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
如果你成功制作了符文石，它会自动成为你成为卢恩骑士后使用的符文石，所以请尽力而为。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
The total number of rune stones you need to make is 20.
Remember that well.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
你需要制作的符文石总数是20个。
请牢记这一点。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
If you remember the books you've read in the library just before, you'll be able to produce a rune stone here without my explanation.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
如果你还记得刚才在图书馆读过的书，你就不需要我的解释，也能在这里制作符文石。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
If you succeed in making the rune stone automatically it becomes the rune stone you'll use for yourself when you succeed, and it's delivered to Captain Tigris...so try hard.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
如果你成功制作了符文石，它会自动成为你成功晋升后使用的符文石，并交付给船长 提格里斯...所以请加油。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
The number of total rune stones you need to make is exactly 20. Remember that well.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
你需要制作的符文石总数正好是20个。请牢记这一点。

scripts.text: Check number of made runes?
scripts.translation: 查看已制作符文数量？

scripts.text: I've made all the 20 rune stones.
scripts.translation: 我已经制作了全部20个符文石。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
The number of rune stones made 'til now is {0}.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
目前为止制作的符文石数量是{0}。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Hey! I think I told you to make at least 20.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
嘿！我想我告诉过你要制作至少20个。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
You've brought just the right amount. I'll hand over all the finished rune stones to Captain Tigris.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
你带来的数量正好。我会把所有完成的符文石交给船长 提格里斯。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Wow! What's this? You've made over 20. It's ok for now but remember to follow directions next time.
I'll hand over all the made rune stones to Captain Tigris.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
哇！这是什么？你制作了超过20个。现在没关系，但下次请记得遵循指示。
我会把所有制作的符文石交给船长 提格里斯。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Because there is a test waiting for you that uses these rune stones.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
因为有一项使用这些符文石的测试在等着你。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Here, you've passed. Go back to Captain Tigris and complete the next test.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
好了，你通过了。回到船长 提格里斯那里，完成下一项测试。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Ha! You did a good job considering how difficult my test is. If you were nervous, you can relax now.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
哈！考虑到我的测试有多难，你做得很好。如果你感到紧张，现在可以放松了。

scripts.text: Become a proud Rune Knight.
scripts.translation: 成为自豪的卢恩骑士。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Ah? What are you talking about, Renoa? Don't talk in such a manner! You make us sound like criminals.
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
啊？你在说什么，雷诺阿？别用那种语气说话！你让我们听起来像罪犯一样。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight, Renoa]
Well, there is an unidentified person here.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
嗯，这里有一个身份不明的人。

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Ah... hey, friend, come over here and let us talk for a minute...
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
啊...嘿，朋友，过来这边，让我们聊一会儿...

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Renoa]
You don't want to touch that thing. Believe me, I'm not kidding.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 雷诺阿]
别碰那个东西。相信我，我没在开玩笑。

scripts.text: I can see a hole under the huge Rune Stone Statue behind Renoa. Clearly this is a mass-produced rune heating furnace that I read in the book.

scripts.text: The birth of Rune Knights

scripts.text: Runes and Magic Energy
scripts.translation: 符文与魔力

scripts.text: Stop Reading

scripts.text: Rune Knights are the gathering of evolved swordmen who have achieved the harmony of sword and magic.
scripts.translation: 卢恩骑士是由进化后的剑士组成的群体，他们实现了剑与魔力的和谐统一。

scripts.text: It had been achieved by the legendary swordsman Beljeve who's been known as a Sword Master and a founder of dispensable expenditure.
scripts.translation: 这一成就由传奇剑士贝尔杰夫达成，他被誉为剑术大师，也是符文消耗理论的奠基人。

scripts.text: Rune Knights use rune stones as a medium for magic power rather than using the magical energy made directly within the body.
scripts.translation: 卢恩骑士使用符文石作为魔力的媒介，而不是直接使用体内产生的魔力。

scripts.text: Magic power could only previously be used by those who can harness magic power within their bodies through a long time of research
scripts.translation: 过去，只有那些通过长期研究能在体内驾驭魔力的人才能使用魔力。

scripts.text: However, for the direct research on the rune magical power which had broken the human's normal concept is now ongoing.
scripts.translation: 然而，针对符文魔力——这种打破人类常规认知的力量——的直接研究正在进行中。

scripts.text: It's known that the Sword Master Beljeve felt the limit of his power, so he studied the way to overcome the physical limitation of mortals.
scripts.translation: 据记载，剑术大师贝尔杰夫感受到了自身力量的极限，因此他开始研究如何突破凡人的肉体限制。

scripts.text: We guess he had been already in touch with the Laphine tribe long before the dimensional rift was discovered to get to the Ash-Vacuum.
scripts.translation: 我们推测，早在发现通往阿什真空的次元裂缝之前，他就已经与拉芬族有了接触。

scripts.text: The Laphine tribe are the fairies from the Ash-Vacuum and are known to have a close relationship to the birth of the Rune Knights.
scripts.translation: 拉芬族是来自阿什真空的精灵，它们与卢恩骑士的诞生有着密切的关系。

scripts.text: Now it's possible for those who are normally unsuited to using magic power to carry a medium that can carry magic that normal mortals could not wield before.
scripts.translation: 如今，那些原本不适合使用魔力的人，也可以通过承载魔力的媒介，施展出普通凡人无法驾驭的力量。

scripts.text: The result of studying these techniques are the rune stones tuned in harmony with the physical power of swords.
scripts.translation: 研究这些技术的成果，便是能与剑的物理力量和谐共鸣的符文石。

scripts.text: Beljeve's disciples who started to learn the way to imbue their swords with rune stones became known as Rune Knights.
scripts.translation: 开始学习将符文石注入剑中的贝尔杰夫弟子们，便被称为卢恩骑士。

scripts.text: A jewel called as a Rune is a medium that contains the formless existence, the magical power and the essence of it can be used directly.
scripts.translation: 被称为符文的宝石，是一种蕴含无形存在、魔力及其本质的媒介，可以直接加以利用。

scripts.text: The Laphine Sage, Serpeone and the founder of Rune Knights Beljeve co-researched runes and the result of their research has only recently become to be known to the world.
scripts.translation: 拉芬族的贤者瑟佩奥恩与卢恩骑士的创始人贝尔杰夫共同研究了符文，他们的研究成果直到最近才为世人所知。

scripts.text: It's a limitless alternative energy source and research on them is still ongoing.
scripts.translation: 这是一种无限的替代能源，目前对它的研究仍在进行中。

scripts.text: Unlike humans, the living things in the Ash-Vacuum preserve magical energy by holding it in their bodies.
scripts.translation: 与人类不同，阿什真空中的生物通过将魔力储存在体内来保存能量。

scripts.text: The discovery of transferring this magical power into runes was refined by Beljeve and Serpeone and shared with the Rune Knights.
scripts.translation: 将这种魔力转移到符文中的发现，经过贝尔杰夫和瑟佩奥恩的完善，并传授给了卢恩骑士。

scripts.text: The principle use of Runes
scripts.translation: 符文的主要用途

scripts.text: The types of Runes
scripts.translation: 符文的种类

scripts.text: Stop Reading
scripts.translation: 停止阅读

scripts.text: A rune is a kind of symbol that's been used on the Midgard continent since ancient times. Up until now it has only been used by occult circles.
scripts.translation: 符文是一种自远古时代起就在米德加尔特大陆使用的符号。直到现在，它主要只被神秘学圈子所使用。

scripts.text: Runes are used as a symbol system, however, by the story handed down orally, it's known to be used for fortune-telling or used to draw out the human sub consciousness.
scripts.translation: 虽然符文被用作一种符号系统，但根据口耳相传的故事，它也被用于占卜或挖掘人类的潜意识。

scripts.text: Runes have their own system and types and can draw out various powers according to how they are arranged. But their power level can't currently be measured by known means.
scripts.translation: 符文拥有自己的体系和种类，根据其排列方式可以激发出不同的力量。但目前尚无法用已知手段测量其力量等级。

scripts.text: It is fortunate that the Rune Knights discovered their use for positive means. Runes have not been used for dark magic but it is certainly possible for their power to be misused if in the wrong hands.
scripts.translation: 幸运的是，卢恩骑士发现了符文的正面用途。虽然符文未被用于黑暗魔法，但如果落入坏人之手，其力量确实有可能被滥用。

scripts.text: The runes are created from a a total of 25 small stones and they are very fragile to physical shock. So they require special care when being handled.
scripts.translation: 符文由总共25颗小石头组成，它们对物理冲击非常脆弱，因此在处理时需要格外小心。

scripts.text: The 25 stones have different meanings and among these, 14 when counter-positioned can have entirely different power and meaning from the original so it's essential to study the exceptional aspects.
scripts.translation: 这25颗石头有着不同的含义。其中14颗在反向排列时，会拥有与原本完全不同的力量和含义，因此必须研究其特殊之处。

scripts.text: The other 11 runes have consistent power, not influenced by any position so if you don't master all 11 ordinary runes and the 14 inverse runes, you cannot draw out all the complete power.
scripts.translation: 其余11颗符文的力量是恒定的，不受位置影响。因此，如果不掌握全部11颗普通符文和14颗反向符文，就无法发挥出完整的力量。

scripts.text: Among the 11 ordinary runes, the blank rune is an exception.
scripts.translation: 在11颗普通符文之中，空白符文是一个例外。

scripts.text: The making of Rune stones is achieved through a skill called rune mastery which is learned when one becomes a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation: 符文石的制造是通过一种名为符文精熟的技能实现的，该技能在成为卢恩骑士时习得。

scripts.text: Rune Mastery is like a code that's been put into the body as a mark of a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation: 符文精熟就像刻在卢恩骑士身上的印记，是一种融入体内的代码。

scripts.text: Ordinary people can also learn this skill and it needs its own machine called a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 普通人也可以学习这项技能，但需要使用一种名为符文熔炉的机器。

scripts.text: When you making a Rune stone with a Rune Furnace, the type of rune is determined by the magical energy put into it, and it cannot be changed.
scripts.translation: 使用符文熔炉制造符文石时，符文的种类由注入的魔法能量决定，且无法更改。

scripts.text: When making a rune stone by using Rune Mastery, it can be made into the rune property that you want but it's classified as a Rune Knights' own ability.
scripts.translation: 使用符文精熟制造符文石时，可以制成想要的符文属性，但这被归类为卢恩骑士的专属能力。

scripts.text: When you operate the Rune Furnace, the magical energy of the body gets concentrated through it and it enables the change into a Rune Stone.
scripts.translation: 操作符文熔炉时，体内的魔法能量会经由熔炉聚集，从而转化为符文石。

scripts.text: Ansuz - This rune means preparation or arrangement and the power that can overcome the uneasiness of the coming future. This is shaped into the form of an emerald round in a Rune Furnace.

scripts.text: Rhydo - This rune means the combination and recombination and the power of completion. This is shaped into the sky-blue oblique line in a Rune Furnace.

scripts.text: Turisus - This rune means the border and the power of limitation. This is shaped into a yellow round in a Rune Furnace.

But when you become a Rune Knight, you'll need to make sure that you join the expeditionary team in order to fully explore the Ash-Vacuum.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 贤者卫兵]
但当你成为卢恩骑士后，为了完全探索阿什真空，你必须加入远征队。

scripts.text:
[Dispatched Rune Knight]
Thanks for your work. We will continue our mission for the Rune Knight testers.
scripts.translation:
[派遣的卢恩骑士]
感谢你的工作。
我们将继续为卢恩骑士测试者执行任务。

scripts.text:
[Dispatched Rune Knight]
I've been waiting for you Rune Knight candidate. I'm helping the candidates as a favor to Ms. Serpeone.
scripts.translation:
[派遣的卢恩骑士]
我一直在等你，卢恩骑士候选人。
我是出于对塞尔佩奥内女士的敬意来协助候选人的。

scripts.text:
[Dispatched Rune Knight]
Shh... Our mission is not something to be revealed to the public. Please just move along.
scripts.translation:
[派遣的卢恩骑士]
嘘... 我们的任务不能向公众透露。
请继续赶路吧。

scripts.text:
[Dispatched Rune Knight]
Do you want to go out to the Splendide field?
scripts.translation:
[派遣的卢恩骑士]
你想去辉煌领域野外吗？

scripts.text:
[Dispatched Rune Knight]
Do you want to go back to the expeditionary team's post?
scripts.translation:
[派遣的卢恩骑士]
你想回到远征队的据点吗？

scripts.text: [Dispatched Rune Knight]
scripts.translation: [派遣的卢恩骑士]

scripts.text: Move to Splendide field
scripts.translation: 前往辉煌领域野外

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Yes please.
scripts.translation: 是的，请送我回去

scripts.text: Not yet.
scripts.translation: 还没有准备好。

scripts.text: - Whispers of the sage Serpeone are delivered to my mind. -
scripts.translation: - 贤者塞尔佩奥内的低语传入我的脑海。 -

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
Until you become an honorable Rune Knight I cannot help you control your powers in Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
在你成为光荣的卢恩骑士之前，我无法帮助你在米德加尔特控制你的力量。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
Please understand this and be devoted to this test.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
请理解这一点，并专心投入这场考试。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
Finally you are an honorable Rune Knight. I'm happy to help you.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
终于，你成为了光荣的卢恩骑士。我很乐意帮助你。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
It must be surprising that I, a Laphine, am here in your people's base.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
我作为拉菲涅人，出现在你们人类的基地，这一定让你感到惊讶吧。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
Welcome, you are the one taking the job training test of the Rune Knights. I am Serpeone.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
欢迎，你是参加卢恩骑士职业训练考试的人。我是塞尔佩奥内。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
Are you gathering enough magical energy? Or do you have any questions?
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
你正在收集足够的魔法能量吗？或者你有什么问题？

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
Are you ready to go back to the Rune Knight gathering place?
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
你准备好回到卢恩骑士的聚集地了吗？

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
Are the preparations going well?
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
准备工作进展得顺利吗？

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
The power of Runes are not perfect and more research still needs to be done to make it perfectly safe. It is up to me and other Rune Knights like you to make sure to continue that research.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
卢恩的力量尚不完美，为了确保其绝对安全，仍需进行更多的研究。这取决于我，以及像你一样的卢恩骑士们，继续推进这项研究。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
Please be devoted to the Runes and hopefully your life will be illuminated by it.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
请全心全意地奉献给卢恩，愿你的生命因此得到照亮。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
Some of us have been in contact with humans in special situations since even before the dimensional rift opened up.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
早在次元裂缝出现之前，我们中的一些人就已经在特殊情况下与人类建立了联系。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
I have been having correspondences with humans for a number of years now. It was for mutual interests. Anyway, that's how I learned your language.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
我已经与人类通信好几年了。那是出于共同的利益。总之，我就是这样学会了你们的语言的。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
Maybe there needs to be a machine that can translate the Laphine language to make it easier for humans to understand us.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
也许我们需要一台机器来翻译拉菲涅语，这样人类就能更容易地理解我们了。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
More than that... I cannot tell you more. I cannot speak carelessly since I'm speaking for my people here and I am on a special pass to be allowed in your camp.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
除此之外...我不能透露更多。既然我是代表我的族人说话，而且我是持特别通行证进入你们营地的，所以我不能随意发言。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
All Rune Knights that you've met so far are the disciples who were taught by me and Beljeve. Now you are on your way to joining them.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
你之前遇到的所有卢恩骑士，都是由我和贝尔杰夫教导的弟子。现在，你也即将加入他们的行列。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
I think you've already heard a basic explanation and instructions from Renoa. Now it seems that it's my turn to help you out.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
我想你已经从蕾诺亚那里听到了基本的说明和指导。现在，轮到我来帮助你了吗。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
The magical power that the Rune Knights use are not technically the same as the magical power made in the human world.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
卢恩骑士所使用的魔力，在技术上与人类世界产生的魔力并不相同。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
Right this place... our sphere where you call as Ash-Vacuum...it's the magical power made with
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
就在这个地方...你们称之为阿什真空的领域...这是由...产生的魔力

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
The living things in this place have been preserving the magical energy in our bodies unlike the living things in the human world.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
这里的生物与人类世界的生物不同，它们一直在体内保存着魔法能量。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
The power of the rune stones is the way of shaping the magical power in our bodies into runes which take place of our bodies as a medium.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
卢恩石的力量，就是将我们体内的魔力塑造成卢恩，并取代身体作为媒介的方式。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
So to use the rune stone you need a direct understanding of the other sphere's living things.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
因此，要使用卢恩石，你需要直接理解另一个领域的生物。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
But, it must be too much for you to extract the magical energy from the living things in this land yet.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
但是，对于现在的你来说，从这片土地的生物中提取魔法能量可能还为时过早。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
Now I'll cast a magic spell on your body so you can gather magic energy from other living things.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
现在我要在你的身上施加一个魔法，这样你就可以从其他生物那里收集魔法能量了。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
Temporarily you'll able to extract magic energy from evil creatures in the human world. Of course you won't be able to use the energy directly...
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
暂时，你将能够从人类世界的邪恶生物中提取魔法能量。当然，你无法直接使用这种能量...

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
If you store up the energy by getting rid of evil creatures in the human world, I'll convert it to the energy that you can use.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
如果你通过消灭人类世界的邪恶生物来积蓄能量，我会将其转化为你可以使用的能量。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
The vicious souls that they keep even after being dead is the great source of magical powers.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
它们死后依然保留的邪恶灵魂，是魔力的巨大源泉。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
Please get rid of ^0000FF10 Dullahan^000000, ^0000FF10 Disguise^000000, ^0000FF10 Quve^000000, ^0000FF10 Heirozoist^000000 and gather their energy.

[Sage Serpeone]
I am telling you beforehand but I don't test or judge your qualification. A Rune Knight will be the judge of that.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
我先说明一下，我不负责测试或评判你的资质。那将由卢恩骑士来判定。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
If you have any problems or any questions, please talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
如果你有任何问题或疑问，请随时来找我。

scripts.text: I've gathered enough energy.
scripts.translation: 我已经收集了足够的能量。

scripts.text: To the gathering place.
scripts.translation: 前往集合地点。

scripts.text: Stop the conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
Is it so? Then let's check this out.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
是吗？那让我们来看看。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
Umm, this is great. Enough amount of living body magical energy has accumulated in your body.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
嗯，这很不错。你的身体里已经积蓄了足够多的生物魔法能量。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
Rune Knight Renoa will tell you the way of using rune stones.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
卢恩骑士 雷诺阿会告诉你如何使用符文石。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
Now I think my part is all over. I hope you will become an honorable Rune Knight.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
我想我的部分已经结束了。希望你能成为一名光荣的卢恩骑士。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
If you have any business here, I'll send you to the Rune Knight gathering place. If you are ready, please tell me.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
如果你还有事要办，我会送你去卢恩骑士的集合地点。如果你准备好了，请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
You haven't collected enough magical energy yet.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
你还没有收集到足够的魔法能量。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
Please brace yourself and gather enough energy by dispatching those monsters.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
请做好准备，通过消灭那些魔物来收集足够的能量。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
You want to go back to the gathering place? If you want I'll send you back there immediately. But to continue the test you'll need to come and see me again.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
你想回到集合地点吗？如果你愿意，我可以立刻送你回去。但若要继续测试，你需要再来见我。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
Do you want to go back the Rune Knight gathering place?
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
你想回到卢恩骑士的集合地点吗？

scripts.text: I want to go back.
scripts.translation: 我想回去。

scripts.text: I want to cancel.
scripts.translation: 我想取消。

scripts.text: I want to go back now.
scripts.translation: 我想现在回去。

scripts.text: I am not ready yet.
scripts.translation: 我还没准备好。

scripts.text: Are the preparations going well?
scripts.translation: 准备得怎么样了？

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
Aren't you in the wrong state right now?
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
你现在的状态不对吧？

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
Then I'll send you to the Rune Knight gathering place where you should be.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
那我会送你去卢恩骑士的集合地点，那里才是你应该在的地方。

scripts.text: I'll go back now.
scripts.translation: 我现在就回去。

scripts.text: I'll stay.
scripts.translation: 我要留下。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
Some of us have been in contact with humans in special situations since even before the dimensional rift opened up.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
早在次元裂缝出现之前，我们中的一些人就已经在特殊情况下与人类建立了联系。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
I have been having correspondences with humans for a number of years now. It was for mutual interests. Anyway, that's how I learned your language.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
我已经与人类通信好几年了。那是出于共同的利益。总之，我就是这样学会了你们的语言的。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
Maybe there needs to be a machine that can translate the Laphine language to make it easier for humans to understand us.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
也许我们需要一台机器来翻译拉菲涅语，这样人类就能更容易地理解我们了。

scripts.text:
[Sage Serpeone]
More than that... I cannot tell you more. I cannot speak carelessly since I'm speaking for my people here and I am on a special pass to be allowed in your camp.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 塞尔佩奥内]
除此之外...我不能透露更多。既然我是代表我的族人说话，而且我是持特别通行证进入你们营地的，所以我不能随意发言。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
You still smell like a fledging. Bring honor to the Rune Knights and raise your power...
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
你身上还带着雏鸟的气息。为卢恩骑士带来荣耀，提升你的力量...

scripts.text: A very cold feeling Rune Knight dressed in black from head to toe is scowling at me.
scripts.translation: 一个从头到脚都穿着黑色衣服的卢恩骑士，散发着冰冷的气息，正皱着眉头看着我。

scripts.text: Why are all of the Rune Knights blabberers or uncommunicative and combative...?
scripts.translation: 为什么卢恩骑士们要么喋喋不休，要么沉默寡言且好斗...

scripts.text:
[Captain Tigris]
Hey... What about me? I'm not like that!
scripts.translation:
[船长 提格里斯]
嘿...我呢？我不像那样！

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
I didn't think that a candidate would make it to me today...
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
没想到今天会有候选人来到我面前...

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
Congratulations! You are at the long-waited final test... I think you've mastered the basics now.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
恭喜！你终于迎来了期待已久的最终测试...我想你已经掌握了基础。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
The final test is relatively simple. Everything ends when you get rid of all the magical monsters in this Glast Heim...
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
最终测试相对简单。只要清除格拉斯特海姆所有的魔法魔物，一切就结束了...

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
The only condition is that you have to get rid of these monsters by using the rune stones you made at the former test.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
唯一的条件是，你必须使用在上一轮测试中制作的符文石来消灭这些魔物。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
For this test, only a one-hand weapon, a shield or a two-handed weapon can be equipped.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
在本次测试中，只能装备单手武器、盾牌或双手武器。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
The only set of weapons you can use should be within the weight limit of 400. Rune stones to be provided are 30 attack-only rune stones and 30 defense-only rune stones.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
你只能使用一套重量限制在400以内的武器。将提供30个仅攻击符文石和30个仅防御符文石。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
To use these runes, I will cast a special buff spell over you.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
为了使用这些符文，我将对你施加一个特殊的增益魔法。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
The magical monsters are the 3 kinds of magic monsters from Glast Heim that you might already know... It won't be an easy fight but if you just undergo this final suffering, you'll walk the path of a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
魔法魔物是你在格拉斯特海姆可能已经熟悉的3种魔法魔物...战斗不会轻松，但只要你经受住这最后的考验，你就能踏上卢恩骑士的道路。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
To help the preparation we've made a contract with the Kafra headquarters in Al De Baran by employing a Kafra Employee especially for this gathering place. So it would be good to visit her.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
为了协助准备，我们与艾尔帕兰的卡普拉总部签订了契约，专门为此集合地点雇用了一名卡普拉 职员。所以最好去拜访她。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
If you are ready just talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
如果你准备好了，就再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
If all of your preparations are done, I'll send you to the final test field.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
如果你已经做好了所有准备，我会送你去最终测试场地。

scripts.text: Enter the final test field.
scripts.translation: 进入最终测试场地

scripts.text: I'm not ready yet.
scripts.translation: 我还没准备好。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
For this test, only a one-hand weapon, a shield or a two-handed weapon can be equipped. Keep your other equipments with the Kafra Employee in the center.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
在本次测试中，只能装备单手武器、盾牌或双手武器。请将其他装备寄存在中央的卡普拉 职员处。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
Haven't you failed at the test... If you fail once, you cannot enter again for 10 minutes.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
你难道没有通过测试吗...如果你失败一次，10分钟内无法再次进入。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
It's a consideration for the other testers who are waiting for the test, just like you, so come back after the designated time.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
这是为了体谅像您一样正在等待测试的其他考生，请在指定时间后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
The only set of weapons you can use should be within the weight limit of 400. Rune stones to be provided are 30 attack-only rune stones and 30 defense-only rune stones.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
你只能使用一套重量限制在400以内的武器。将提供30个仅攻击符文石和30个仅防御符文石。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
The remaining stuff you are holding should be kept by the Kafra employee in the middle.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
您手中剩下的物品，请寄存在中间的卡普拉 职员处。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
Looks like there is already an applicant in the test room.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
看起来测试房间里已经有考生了。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
Be patient and wait your turn.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
请耐心等待，轮到您时再进去。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
Wait, I'll collect all the rune stones provided before. There's a certain limit on using the rune stones that's made for the test.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
等等，我要先回收之前发放的所有符文石。用于测试的符文石使用数量是有限制的。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
I'll get new rune stones so if your preparation is all done, please talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
我会准备新的符文石。如果您已经做好了所有准备，请再次与我对话。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
You've been very successful up to the last test.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
直到最后一项测试，您都表现得非常出色。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
Now all the tests you need to take are over. Go back to Captain Tigris and inform him of this test result, and then feel the deep emotion of being born again as a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
现在，您需要参加的所有测试都结束了。请回到船长 提格里斯那里告知他测试结果，然后感受作为卢恩骑士重生的深刻情感吧。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
Congratulations!
Well I'd better go now for the remaining candidates.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
恭喜您！
好了，我得去接待剩下的考生了。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
Wait, I'll collect all the rune stones provided before. There's a certain limit on using the rune stones that's made for the test.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
等等，我要先回收之前发放的所有符文石。用于测试的符文石使用数量是有限制的。

scripts.text:
[Rune Knight Velpino]
I'll need to re-use these unused rune stones. Talk to me again once I have taken all the test rune stones.
scripts.translation:
[卢恩骑士 维尔皮诺]
我需要重新利用这些未使用的符文石。等我回收完所有测试符文石后，请再次与我对话。

scripts.text: A very cold feeling Rune Knight dressed in black from head to toe is scowling at me.
scripts.translation: 一个从头到脚都穿着黑色衣服的卢恩骑士，散发着冰冷的气息，正皱着眉头看着我。

scripts.text: Enter the Password.
scripts.translation: 请输入密码。

scripts.translation: 卢恩骑士更换职业管理模块启动
